name: 0. the player stands where the game offers an action (the control for what follows)
0b. control: phone closed, the action key acts (a menu opens, the game leaves « play », or the player goes through the door)
0c. back at the same spot, the action offered again
1. a tap on ☰ opens the phone on its home screen, the game hands over (movement off)

1b. the status bar: the city’s time and day (the HUD’s own), the sky of the hour, the energy as the battery, « Fermer » (≥ 44 px); no app header on the home screen; the home indicator at the bottom (a 44 px target)

1c. the home screen: a dock always in view (Carte, Travailler, Argent, Messages, and the library) and EVERY app as an icon, one tap away (hook apps with their module); at least four rows in view above the dock; every tile a finger wide; nothing sideways
2. phone open: a thumb on the stick, a camera drag, a tap where the action button is, E, Espace and a held W — the player has not moved, the camera has not turned, nothing was triggered
3. ONE tap on the dock’s « Argent » opens the app: its header says « ‹ Accueil · Argent »
3b. Réglages › Tester le son: the header says « ‹ Réglages »; « back » returns to Réglages scrolled where it was left
4. the home indicator returns to the home screen from two screens deep; Réglages, tapped again, is where it was left (Tester le son, and under it the list at its scroll)
4b. the home indicator on the home screen stays on the home screen (the phone stays open)
5. the library lists every app by theme; Profil opened from it says « ‹ Toutes les apps » and returns there
6. a double tap on ☰ opens the phone and leaves it open, whether the second tap lands on « Fermer » (now under the finger) or still on ☰
6b. a double tap on « Fermer » closes the phone and leaves it closed (☰ is under the finger: the second tap is dropped); the game is back in play
6c. two separate taps stay two taps: ☰ opens the phone, « Fermer » (the same spot) closes it
7. « Fermer » pressed with Entrée, then with Espace (the game’s action keys): the phone closes and nothing is triggered in the street
8. the phone closed: the player is where they stood, in play, no menu opened by anything above
8b. nothing keeps walking after the phone (no stuck stick, no stuck key)
8c. and the stick moves the player again (a few steps, as a thumb asks)
9. ☰ tapped while the other thumb holds the stick: the phone opens, the walk stops, and it does not resume when the phone closes with the thumb still down
10. closed on an app, the phone reopens on it
11. opening the phone and switching between seven apps (the median of five visits each): a few ms of script each, the home screen a small page, and no map engine loaded before the Carte is asked for
12. no page error
